answer: Require every agent to lock a bond before claiming a task. A public task receipt lets anyone prove that two identities claimed the same exclusive reward; the contract then slashes the duplicate’s bond and pays part to the challenger. Creating a swarm of sybils therefore ties up capital per account and risks forfeiture, rather than granting influence for free. A cipher can protect private credentials, while a terrace of accounts still faces the same bond and a pearl of reputation must be earned.
